name: Poisonous Foliage
body:
Prerequisite(s): Wood blast.

Benefit(s): You treat laced infusion, sickening infusion, and psychotropic infusion as wood-element wild talents, allowing you to apply them to wood blast, great oak blast, verdant blast, and any composite blast for which wood blast is a prerequisite. These infusions are poison effects when used this way. If you use any of these infusions with nightshade blast, increase the DC of your blast by 1.
